text.en: Original-image searches retain their current query plan. Reviews use stage-specific rules and recheck focal content after cropping; canvas status distinguishes failed work from results needing review. Thumbnail preparation runs within a shared concurrency limit.
text.zh-CN: 修复原图搜索检索词被覆盖和审核阶段规则混淆的问题，裁剪后重新核对主体，画布区分失败与待复核，并在共享并发上限内准备缩略图。
